capabilities: Add a colored handwritten-style annotation to selected text
Store annotations in the Markdown file as portable HTML
Edit or delete annotations while preserving the original prose
Distribute labels above and below paragraphs with collision lanes and connected arrows
Follow Obsidian's interface language with English and Chinese controls
disambiguation: Not a freehand drawing or pen-input tool; annotations are typed labels styled to look handwritten.
extras: The README says the plugin has not yet been accepted into the Obsidian Community Plugins directory and provides manual installation steps; disabling the plugin keeps the prose and metadata but hides the rendered annotations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach handwritten-looking annotations to prose without covering or reflowing the annotated text.
summary: Handwritten-style annotation plugin that adds colored labels with arrows above and below selected text, stored as portable HTML.
